CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListPrepend

Returns a copy of a list with a new element added at the front.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListPrepend(list, value [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to add to. It may be empty.
value
The element to add.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma. The first character is the one placed between the new element and the old list.

Returns

The new list.

Usage

If the list is empty, the result is just the new element. ListAppend adds to the end; ListInsertAt adds anywhere in between.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Countdown = "">
<CFLOOP INDEX="I" FROM="1" TO="10">
  <CFSET Countdown = ListPrepend(Countdown, I)>
</CFLOOP>
<CFSET Countdown = ListAppend(Countdown, "Happy New Year!")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P><B>#ListChangeDelims(Countdown, "... ")#</B></P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListAppend, ListInsertAt, ArrayPrepend
